windowsDisclaimer.title: Windows — before you install
paragraphs: Windows is supported, but I haven’t run it through as much real-world testing as macOS yet; expect rough edges.
The Windows installer isn’t code-signed yet (no paid certificate), so SmartScreen may warn until you confirm you trust the installer — and the overall experience might be flaky.
If you try it anyway, bug and regression reports are hugely welcome — I’m keen for contributors on Windows; use the GitHub link in this section.

headline: Your words stay
on your machine.
hero.sub: Record calls, transcribe files, dictate text. Entirely offline. No keys, no cloud, no subscription.

modes.label: what it does
headline: Three modes.
One menu bar icon.
modes.sub: Pick the right tool for the moment. Switch anytime from the menu bar.

items.label: Scribe
items.title: Background call recorder
items.body: Runs silently. Captures both sides of a call via dual-channel recording. Mic bleed suppression keeps the channels clean.
features: Saves markdown to a folder you choose

items.label: Transcribe
items.title: File transcription
items.body: Drop any audio file. Get a clean timestamped transcript. All processing is local.
features: Multiple Whisper model sizes to choose from

items.label: Dictate
items.title: Hotkey speech-to-text
items.body: Tap a key, speak, release. Text transcribes and pastes into whatever app is in focus. Works system-wide.
features: Optional VAD skips silence between words

steps.title: Download the .dmg
steps.body: Mount, drag to Applications. No account, no App Store, no subscription. A menu bar icon appears on first launch.

steps.title: Grant mic access
steps.body: Allow microphone (and Accessibility on Mac if you use Dictate paste). The Whisper model is already in the app — nothing to download.

steps.title: Pick a mode
steps.body: Record a note, Upload a file, or Dictate with the hotkey. Configure once and forget it.

steps.title: Plain markdown output
steps.body: Transcripts save to a folder of your choice. Grep them. Pipe them. Open in anything. They're yours.

privacy.label: privacy
headline: Private by
architecture.
privacy.sub: Not a setting. Not a promise. Audio is processed entirely on your hardware. There is no server.

pillars.title: No cloud
pillars.body: Whisper runs locally. Audio never leaves the device. No API keys required.

pillars.title: No account
pillars.body: Download and run. No signup, no email, no telemetry of any kind.

pillars.title: Offline by default
pillars.body: Models ship in the app. No Hugging Face at runtime. Optional update check only if you click it. Verifiable with a packet capture.

download.label: download
download.headline: Run it today.
download.sub: Free and open source. macOS 12+ and Windows 64-bit.
